subject: 1604CF (July 2008 ENCS) page 1, Part I item 4, the fourth (branch-code) group of the TIN comb chain: the printed box x 204.24-250.80, y 129.84-144.72 pt (top-left origin) in the pinned source '1604-CF July 2008 ENCS final.pdf' sha256 877fbeee071752b2d9af72924647196e6dafa71a2412e74bc9f17897767cc2e7. There is no BIR field key for it in this checkout: no rules/forms/1604cf* directory exists, so official_field_key is recorded as 'none — no harvested field_key in this checkout' rather than borrowed from a 2018 successor form. The cell id p1c13 is a HINT only: cell ids are quantised bounding boxes and renumber on any geometry change, so the printed box is what identifies the subject and the edit anchor below is what binds it to a batch.
what: The branch-code comb carries five compartments instead of four, inside the SAME printed box. Nothing is widened, moved or repainted: the box stays 46.56 x 14.88pt at 204.24,129.84, the writing surface stays top 0.72pt / height 13.44pt, the inputs keep class 'fi fh17 fc', and the five compartments divide the box equally -- left(i) = round(i * 46.56 / 5, 2) giving 0 / 9.31 / 18.62 / 27.94 / 37.25pt and widths 9.31 / 9.31 / 9.32 / 9.31 / 9.31pt, which sum to exactly 46.56pt. The equal division does NOT preserve the consumed batch's horizontal insets (first slot left 0.36pt, last slot right 46.56 - (35.04 + 11.16) = 0.36pt); it divides the full printed box, so those two 0.36pt insets are spent and the writing surface gains 0.72pt of width. Each compartment carries one text input, maxlength 1, sharing the group's field name, slot indexes 0..4 contiguous. Declared pitch attribute 9.31 (nominal 46.56/5 = 9.312).
reason: BIR's July-2008 artwork for 1604CF is CORRECT and OUT OF DATE, and it is out of date by one compartment rather than two. Measured from the pinned PDF, the branch box prints exactly three internal ticks, at x 216.72, 228.00 and 239.28, each 1.92pt tall at the foot of the box and stroked at 0.72pt -- four compartments, of pitch 12.48 / 11.28 / 11.28 / 11.52pt -- and BIR pre-prints only '000' in it, as three vector bezier outlines at x 208.56-215.04, 219.36-225.84 and 230.64-237.12, leaving the fourth compartment blank. The only valid Philippine TIN is 3-3-3-5 (user rule of 2026-08-15), so a four-compartment branch box cannot hold a branch code at all when the code needs five digits. No rule can derive 'the branch code is five characters' from 2008 ink that prints four boxes, which is exactly why this is a stage-2 correction and not a stage-1 producer bug -- stage 1 read this artwork correctly, and the emitted four slots line up with the three printed ticks to 0.00pt. Unlike C01, this record has NO harvested declaration behind it: there is no rules/forms/1604cf*/fields.json in this checkout, so the change rests on the project rule and on an explicitly stated gap. Filing safety: a branch code is what tells the Bureau WHICH establishment an annual withholding return belongs to. A filer whose branch code needs five digits cannot enter it on today's form at all, so the return files against a truncated code -- in practice branch 000, the head office -- and the branch whose payees were withheld from files nothing. Corpus context, measured from the pinned PDFs on 2026-08-08: of 53 bundles, 39 print 3+3+3+5, three print 3+3+3+3, one prints 3+3+3+4 (1600WP 2010) and ten were reported not measurable. 1604cf-2008 was one of those ten; this record measures it directly and finds 3+3+3+4, so it joins 1600WP in that class. The other nine remain unmeasured and are not corrected here.
authority: Project rule of 2026-08-15 that the only valid Philippine TIN is 3-3-3-5, applied to a form with no harvested field declaration in this checkout — regulation not identified in-repo. This record does NOT reuse C01's harvested-HTA sentence, because there is no harvested declaration to reuse: `ls rules/forms | grep 1604` returns 1604c-v2018, 1604e-v2018 and 1604f-v2018 and no 1604cf directory at all, so there is no field_key, no constraints.max_length and no source_refs to quote for the July-2008 1604CF. The three 2018 successor forms are not a stand-in and do not even agree with one another: frm1604c:branchCode declares max_length 5 (official-hta-runtime#control:L340) and frm1604e:txtBranchCode declares 5 (L359), while frm1604f:branchCode declares 3 (L347). The in-repo corroboration for the 3-3-3-5 shape itself is secondary documentation, not an issuance: docs/tax-profile/CONTEXT.md defines a five-digit Branch Code, and docs/tax-profile/TIN_BRANCH_PROFILE_AND_FILING_GUIDE_2026-08-07.md gives the full filing display 000-000-000-00000. NO BIR issuance is cited, because none in this checkout says when or under what authority 1604CF's branch field became five characters wide; that gap is stated deliberately rather than filled with a plausible-looking regulation number, and it stays visible until someone supplies the real one.
diverges_from: audit.py comb_slots_match_printed on the 1604CF item-4 branch comb -- the corrected document emits five compartments where the pinned artwork prints four, and must keep being reported as an offender of that assertion (failure kind layout-printed-mismatch where the layout carries the change, invalid-emission where only the markup does). audit.py inputs_span_no_printed_divider must gain offenders on the same comb, because five 9.31pt compartments across a box whose printed dividers stand at x 216.72, 228.00 and 239.28 put a printed divider inside three of the five inputs: the new compartment edges fall at 213.55 / 222.86 / 232.18 / 241.49, so compartments 1, 2 and 3 each contain one tick. Every pre-printed '0' outline also ends up straddling a compartment boundary (208.56-215.04 across 213.55, 219.36-225.84 across 222.86, 230.64-237.12 across 232.18); that is a visible cost of the change, and it is recorded rather than smoothed away. Neither check may be allowlisted, excluded or waived to make this correction quiet, and no tolerance moves for it.
verified_by: An independent producer, sharing nothing with whatever writes the correction: the four printed compartments are re-derived from the pinned PDF by a reader that is not extract.py (re-derived while authoring this record by `mutool draw -F trace` and by Poppler `pdftocairo -svg`, both agreeing with PyMuPDF to 0.01pt on the box 204.24-250.80 x 129.84-144.72 and the three ticks 216.72 / 228.00 / 239.28), and the five emitted compartments are re-derived from the written bytes by a parser that reads none of emit.py's markers. Not from build/layout, not from the IR, not from the applier's own manifest, and not from a determinism re-run -- that runs the writer twice and both halves drift together.
